name: Argent
description: Records iOS simulators, Android emulators, web and desktop apps. Saves recordings as flows you can re-shoot when the app changes, and lets the agent drive the app while it records.
author: Software Mansion

agentTools.name: argent_list_devices
agentTools.description: List simulators, emulators and Chromium apps that can be recorded, with their state.

agentTools.name: argent_record
agentTools.description: Record a device. Either replay a saved flow or let the agent drive the app from a goal. Returns the new media id.

flow.description: Path of a saved flow to replay, e.g. flows/login.yaml.

goal.description: What the agent should do in the app while recording.

saveFlow.description: Save what happened as a flow at this path.

agentTools.name: argent_reshoot
agentTools.description: Re-record a media item from its saved flow and swap it in everywhere it is used.
